3 غَارَقَنِى كَذَا (tropical:) Such a thing was, or became, near to me; drew near to me; or approached me. (TA.) And غَارَقَتْهُ المَنِيَّةُ (tropical:) [Death became near to him]. (TA.) ―
-b2- And غَارَقَتِ الوَقْعَةُ (tropical:) The onslaught was, or became, obligatory. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
